# SPD-098 — Bind every code ticket to a worktree and refuse work in a main checkout

## Brief
Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-16-home-tool-split-design.md, section 6 (Eric approved it on 2026-09-16, as a refusal, not a warning). Starts after SPD-097 has landed and the switch-over has run.

The first member new of a ticket whose deliverables land in a project checkout binds the ticket to the session's current linked worktree, whether Eric launched the session in one or Spud entered one. From a main checkout member new refuses and names the EnterWorktree step; from outside the project it names where to start the ticket. Once bound, a member's project paths resolve only inside that worktree, and the edit and Bash hooks refuse the same paths in the main checkout.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer (opus), after the home split has landed and the switch-over has run. It touches the hook path rule, so tests/probes/hook_timing.py gates it.
